title: Local development topology
decision: The browser reaches the API through the Vite proxy. PostgreSQL persists workspace data.
limit: Ports 3000 and 8080 are development defaults; no cloud deployment is asserted.

title: Application architecture
decision: Local draft ownership is separate from server state; the server enforces workspace access.
limit: Arrows summarize selected dependencies and flows; this is not a complete class diagram.

title: Save conflict and deliberate recovery
decision: A stale save is rejected without losing the visible draft. Reload requires a user decision.
limit: Illustrative versions n and n+1; assumes no new edits during the successful save.

title: Release and browser runtime topology
decision: Release gates protect static publication; algorithms and progress execute on the learner device.
limit: Describes repository workflow configuration, not a fresh audit of hosting settings.

title: Execution and visualization architecture
decision: The pure player selects stored steps; controllers own timing, presentation and persistence.
limit: Dotted edge is test/build verification; solid arrows describe selected runtime flows.

title: Predict, reveal, rewind and resume
scope: Behavior / Challenge Mode and guided playback
decision: Prediction feedback precedes movement. Rewind selects stored state; toggling Challenge resets playback.
limit: Invalid input is rejected; device-local persistence is best-effort, not account synchronization.
